direct_syscalls.name: futex
direct_syscalls.notes: Guard uses shared WAIT/WAKE. Patched C++20 backend selects header-supported operations and relative waits. Timed futures try bitset operations and fall back on ENOSYS.

direct_syscalls.name: clock_gettime
direct_syscalls.notes: CLOCK_REALTIME and CLOCK_MONOTONIC are present in reference 2.6.18. Source audit does not establish SELP behavior.

reference_futex_fallback_evidence.unsupported_operations: default returns -ENOSYS; matches the timed-future legacy fallback

atomic32: ARMv6 aligned LDREX/STREX; kernel memory-barrier helper where selected. Owned operations pass on ARM1136 QEMU.
atomic64: std::atomic<uint64_t> is not lock-free; private libatomic uses mutex fallback. HAVE_IFUNC=0, HAVE_ATOMIC_CAS_8=0, HAVE_ATOMIC_LDST_8=0. Legacy __sync 64-bit helpers require kuser v5 and are unsupported.
